fullDescription: A futuristic, dark-mode risk assessment dashboard featuring a minimal segmented gauge, grainy glow aesthetics, and high-contrast typography. The design utilizes a deep charcoal and black palette (#050505, #0a0a0a) punctuated by vibrant status-driven accents in lime, yellow, and red. Ideal for cybersecurity monitoring, fintech risk analysis, SaaS performance dashboards, and real-time system health displays. Key features include a glassmorphism control panel, a radial 'grainy' light leak effect, and smooth, physics-based needle animations.
prompt:
## Resumo
An interactive, high-fidelity risk gauge dashboard with a dark brutalist aesthetic, utilizing neon status indicators and large, ultra-light editorial typography to display real-time data metrics.

## Estilo Visual
Create a design system using a base background of #050505. Typography: 'Manrope' for headings and UI (weights 200, 400, 700) and 'Inter' for data/numbers (weight 200 for large displays). Primary colors: Minimum (#55a630), Low (#aacc00), Medium (#ffb703), High (#ff2d20). UI elements should feature 1px borders with rgba(255,255,255,0.14). Use a grainy noise texture (opacity 0.15) over radial gradients for atmospheric lighting. Animation: Needle movements must use `cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1)` for a snappy, slightly overshooting physical feel. Buttons use background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5) with a 4px backdrop-blur and rounded-full shapes.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Main Container Card
A container with a multi-stop gradient border: `linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(170,204,0,0.8) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.1) 40%, rgba(255,183,3,0.5) 70%, rgba(251,133,0,0.8) 100%)`. Inner padding of 3px to reveal the border. Inner background is solid #0a0a0a with a border-radius of 61px.

### Risk Header
Centered at the top. Top text: 'Risk Level' in 24px Inter, weight 300, tracking 0.2em, color white/80. Main Status: 98px uppercase title, weight 700, Center Aligned with risk level text and container, with a 20px color-matched text-shadow (e.g., #aacc0066).

### Segmented Gauge Section
A 16-cell horizontal grid. Each cell is 24px tall, with a 5px border-radius, border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14). Gaps between cells: 7px. A vertical 'needle' line (2px wide, 48px high) sits above the cells with a circular dot at the bottom and a glow effect. Below the grid, 4 labels (Minimum, Low, Medium, High) in 10px uppercase Inter, tracked 0.16em.

### Percentage Value Display
Dominant central element. Font-size 150px, weight 200, Inter. The number has a vertical gradient from #ffffff to #cccccc. The '%' symbol is 100px, weight 300, placed as a suffix. Below this, a sub-label 'Current Risk' in 17px, tracking 0.15em, white/70.

### Bottom Control Bar
Fixed at the bottom. A row of pill-shaped buttons. 1px border with rgba(255,255,255,0.1). Text is 10px, bold, tracking-widest. Hover state increases border opacity to 0.4. Active state changes border color to the specific risk-level hex code.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Atmospheric Bottom Glow — A dynamic, color-shifting light leak at the bottom of the card.
Positioned at the bottom: A radial-gradient ellipse (120% width, 350px height). The color uses `color-mix(in srgb, var(--active-color) 48%, transparent)`. Overlay this with an SVG fractal noise filter (baseFrequency 0.85) at 0.15 opacity using `mix-blend-mode: overlay` to create a 'dithered' or 'grainy' glow effect.

### Segmented Progress Cells — Status-aware progress indicators.
Cells have two states. Inactive: background rgba(255,255,255,0.045). Active: background is the status color, border-color is lightened (80% color, 20% white), and includes a 12px outer glow and a subtle inner white shadow `inset 0 0 8px rgba(255,255,255,0.28)`. Transition duration: 500ms.

style.description: The style is defined by 'Dark Glassmorphism' and 'Atmospheric Glow'. It pairs the technical feel of Inter for data with the geometric elegance of Manrope for UI elements. The color palette follows a logical progression from safe (Green #55a630) to danger (Red #ff2d20). A signature element is the grainy noise overlay on soft radial gradients, creating a physical, textured light effect.
